description: Source file defining Redux action creators for managing channel bookmarks in Mattermost, including create, delete, edit, reorder, and fetch operations.

methods.name: deleteBookmark
methods.description: Deletes a channel bookmark by channel ID and bookmark ID, dispatching a delete action upon success.

methods.name: createBookmark
methods.description: Creates a new channel bookmark and dispatches a received action with the created bookmark.

methods.name: editBookmark
methods.description: Edits an existing channel bookmark, dispatching update or delete actions based on server response.

methods.name: reorderBookmark
methods.description: Reorders a channel bookmark by updating its sort order and dispatching the updated list.

methods.name: fetchChannelBookmarks
methods.description: Fetches all bookmarks for a channel, handling errors and possibly forcing logout.
